name: eduai
description: EduAI Platform — EduAI Core, AI Tutor, and Question Maker

scripts.docker:dev:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait core-db tutor-db qm-db
scripts.docker:dev:db:tutor: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait core-db tutor-db
scripts.dev:core: npm run dev:core:db && npm run db:migrate:core && npm run dev:core:app
scripts.dev:tutor:app: concurrently -k -n core,tutor-fe,tutor-be -c cyan,blue,green "npm run dev:core:app" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor/server"
scripts.dev:tutor: npm run dev:tutor:db && npm run db:deploy:core && npm run db:deploy:tutor && npm run dev:tutor:app
scripts.dev:qm:app: concurrently -k -n qm-fe,qm-be -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/backend"
scripts.dev:qm: npm run dev:qm:db && npm run dev:qm:app
scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait core-db tutor-db qm-db && npm run db:deploy:core && npm run db:deploy:tutor && concurrently -k -n core,tutor-fe,tutor-be,qm-fe,qm-be -c cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:core:app" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/backend"
scripts.start:tutor: concurrently -k -n tutor-fe,tutor-be -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor" "npm run start --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor/server"
scripts.start:qm: concurrently -k -n qm-fe,qm-be -c magenta,yellow "npm run preview --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/frontend" "npm run start --prefix apps/extensions/question-maker/app/backend"
scripts.install:tutor: npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix apps/extensions/ai-tutor/server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:core && npm run install:tutor && npm run install:qm
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ai-tutor && npm run test:question-maker
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm run test:ai-tutor && npm run test:question-maker:all
scripts.test:ai-tutor: npm run test:ai-tutor:frontend && npm run test:ai-tutor:server
scripts.test:question-maker: npm run test:question-maker:backend && npm run test:question-maker:frontend
scripts.test:question-maker:all: npm run test:question-maker:backend:all && npm run test:question-maker:frontend
